ar.title: كوسة مطبوخة بالزبادي والنعناع

steps.n1: قشّر الكوسة وقطّعها حلقات بسمك 2 سم تقريباً.
steps.n2: اطهها على نار هادئة جداً حتى تخرج عصارتها، ثم صفّها.
steps.n3: أضف بياض البيضة إلى الزبادي (فهو يمنع تفرطه)، ومرّره من مصفاة فوق الكوسة.
steps.n5: رشّ عليها النعناع وقدّمها ساخنة أو باردة.

en.title: Zucchini Simmered in Yogurt with Mint (Kosa Matbukha bi-l-Zabadi)
en.intro: Recipe 432, page 187 from Egyptian Cooking and Other Middle Eastern Recipes (Samia Abdennour, AUC Press)

steps.n1: Peel the zucchini and slice into rounds about 2 cm thick.
steps.n2: Cook them over a very low heat until they give up their juice, then drain.
steps.n3: Stir the egg white into the yogurt (it stops the yogurt curdling) and press it through a sieve over the zucchini.
steps.n4: Season and cook uncovered for 15–20 minutes.
steps.n5: Sprinkle with mint and serve hot or cold.

legacySteps: Peel the zucchini and slice into rounds about 2 cm thick.
Cook them over a very low heat until they give up their juice, then drain.
Stir the egg white into the yogurt (it stops the yogurt curdling) and press it through a sieve over the zucchini.
Season and cook uncovered for 15–20 minutes.
Sprinkle with mint and serve hot or cold.
